name: ak:loop
overview: Autonomous iterative optimization loop — run N iterations against a mechanical metric, learn from git history, auto-keep/discard changes. Use for improving measurable metrics (coverage, performance, bundle size, etc.) through repeated experimentation.
whenToUse: Invoke only when an objective metric can drive repeated trials.

subcommands.name: Goal
subcommands.desc: Human description of what to improve

subcommands.name: Scope
subcommands.desc: search_files capability pattern(s) for editable files

subcommands.name: Verify
subcommands.desc: Shell command that outputs **a single number**

subcommands.name: Noise
subcommands.desc: Tolerance for metric variance: low / medium / high

subcommands.name: Min-Delta
subcommands.desc: Minimum improvement to count as progress

subcommands.name: Direction
subcommands.desc: Whether higher or lower metric value is better
